notes.title: "Unko Technica" to be Exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2025!
notes.content: [p][/p][p]Hello everyone! We are excited to announce that "Unko Technica" will be exhibited at Tokyo Game Show 2025 (TGS2025)![/p][p]At the venue, you can experience the game firsthand at our demo booth. Come feel the stylish and cool atmosphere that you can't get from just a screen![/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Event Details[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Dates:[/b] September 25 (Thu) - 28 (Sun), 2025[/p][list][*][p][i]September 25th and 26th are Business Days.[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Venue:[/b] Hall 9-11 Esplanade[/p][/*][*][p][b]Booth:[/b] SELECTED INDIE 80 Area \[E-62][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116023/75aec2ee82d8d577117124dd0941fb6799919045.png"][/img][/p][p]For more details on TGS2025, please check the official website. [/p][p][url="https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/jp"]https://tgs.cesa.or.jp/jp[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We look forward to seeing you at the venue![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Demo Version Now Available for a Limited Time![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Don't worry if you can't make it to TGS2025! A limited-time demo version is currently available on Steam.[/p][list][*][p][b]Availability:[/b][/p][list][*][p]September 17th (Wed) 3:00 AM PDT ~ September 29th (Mon) 3:00 AM PDT[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Take this opportunity to test your skills in "Unko Technica."[/p]

notes.title: Content Creator & Video Streaming Guidelines - "UNKO TECHNICA"
notes.content: [p]We permit and encourage individuals and corporations to create and stream content for "UNKO TECHNICA" for both commercial and non-commercial purposes. [/p][p]Please adhere to the guidelines below, and enjoy the game with both players and viewers.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ General Guidelines ■[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]▼ When you publish your content, please be sure to include the following:[/p][list][*][p]Clearly state "UNKO TECHNICA" in the title of your video or stream.[/p][/*][*][p]Include the Steam store page URL and the copyright notice in the video description.[/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101010/_/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101010/_/[/url][/p][p]©udonpa Published by Phoenixx Inc.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]■ Prohibited Matters ■[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]▼ Please refrain from editing and posting content that is unrelated to this game. Additionally, do not use the content in a way that significantly damages the game's image or violates public order and morals.[/p][p]▼ Do not engage in slander, libel, or any other behavior that causes a nuisance to other players.[/p][p]▼ Do not separate and post individual elements of the game (such as video, music, or design). Example: "Extracting only the design and using it in a video for another work."[/p][p]▼ Using the posted video for commercial or for-profit purposes is prohibited. However, for both individuals and corporations, if the video is released for free on a video-sharing site and secondary revenue is generated through features officially provided by that site (e.g., the YouTube Partner Program), this will not be considered a for-profit use, so you may use these features without any issues. For any other uses by corporations, please contact us individually.[/p][p]▼ Do not infringe upon the rights of third parties (including intellectual property rights, honor, credibility, portrait rights, and privacy), or use the content in a way that may lead to infringement. If any trouble with a third party arises from your use of the gameplay footage, you are responsible for resolving it. Please be aware in advance that the publisher and developer assume no responsibility.[/p][hr][/hr][p]*Regardless of the reason, if a request is made by the publisher or developer, please promptly delete the post.[/p][p]*Please note that we cannot individually respond to questions regarding the publisher's and developer's handling of or standards for posted videos. We appreciate your understanding.[/p]
